answer: The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the echo. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
